name: toy-consensus-forall-transport
cmd: set -euo pipefail; root=$PWD; out=$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR; export PATH="$root/scripts/lean-gate:$PATH"; mkdir -p "$out/rechecked"; export LEAN_PATH="$out/rechecked:$root/research/bapa:$root/transport-retained/.lake/build/lib/lean"; sha256sum transport-retained/Proofs.lean > "$out/retained-source.sha256"; lean -o "$out/rechecked/Proofs.olean" transport-retained/Proofs.lean > "$out/retained-check.log" 2>&1; lean -o research/bapa/CertificateBoundErasure.olean research/bapa/CertificateBoundErasure.lean 2>&1 | tee "$out/translator.log"; lean -o "$out/rechecked/ToyConsensusForallTransport.olean" research/bapa/ToyConsensusForallTransport.lean 2>&1 | tee "$out/transport.log"; lean research/bapa/ToyConsensusForallControls.lean 2>&1 | tee "$out/controls.log"; cp research/bapa/CertificateBoundErasure.lean research/bapa/ToyConsensusForallTransport.lean research/bapa/ToyConsensusForallControls.lean "$out/"; bunx @commitlint/cli --config research/egraph/historical/commitlint.config.cjs < research/bapa/toy-transport-commit.txt > "$out/commitlint.log" 2>&1
